### `particleIceConfigurationReport(value)`

Validate and normalize a V2 ICE response. Explicit direct mode is strict so a malformed or compromised response cannot smuggle relay credentials into a no-TURN client. Legacy relay responses remain accepted when they contain a real authenticated TURN URL.
